mcrules.text:
Mission control — what shows up

• Live tiles: every session that is working, waiting for input or needs attention, across ALL open projects.
• Earlier today: sessions with output, a status change or a git change in the last 24h. Shown as compact cards, not live terminals.
• Everything else is hidden ("5 quiet sessions"), one click back to Projects.
• Order: needs you → working → most recently updated.
• The scope menu can widen it (last 7 days, all) or narrow it to a single project.

Keys
• Alt-m switches Projects ⇄ Mission control (proposed new chord).
• Arrows move between tiles, ⏎ opens one full size, Alt-Esc goes back to the grid.
• Alt-1…9 follow the tile order, so the same number reaches the same tile in both layouts.
• Every existing chord (⌃P, ⌃F, ⌃T…) acts on the selected tile.
